# XCSP regression fixtures

`LowAutocorrelation-010-mini_c25.xml` is the unchanged XML content of
`XCSP25/MiniCOP25/LowAutocorrelation-010-mini_c25.xml.lzma`.
The XCSP integration tests embed it with `include_str!`, so an offline
source checkout needs no downloaded benchmark corpus.
